name: Psion Abomination
text: Health 5, move 3. Weapons/skills: Overpowered: All other Vek gain +1 HP, Regeneration, and explode on death.. Special: Flying: Flying units can move over any terrain tile.. The Psion Abomination does not attack but instead grants all other Vek "overpowered", combining the effects of the Soldier Psion, Blood Psion and Blast Psion. No other Psions can spawn if the mission contains a Psion Abomination. It will never replace the 4th island's Psion enemy during Unfair difficulty (unless it is the leader of the island for the HQ mission), nor replace the Psion Tyrant during the Volcanic Hive.

name: Spider
text: Health 2, move 2. Weapons/skills: Tiny Offspring: Throw a sticky egg that hatches into a Spiderling.. Spiders have very limited movement, but have the unique ability of throwing a Spiderling Egg on any column or row they are aligned with. This egg traps all surrounding entities in webs upon landing and will hatch into a Spiderling on the next turn. As a rare Vek, Spiders cannot spawn on the first island, and are limited to one spawn per mission (including its alpha).

name: Alpha Spider
text: Health 4, move 2. Weapons/skills: Large Offspring: Throw a sticky egg that hatches into a Spiderling.. Alpha Spiders have very limited movement, but have the unique ability of throwing a Spiderling Egg on any column or row they are aligned with. This egg traps all surrounding entities in webs upon landing and will hatch into a Spiderling on the next turn. The Spiderling's stats from the Alpha Spider are identical to that of the regular Spiders. As a rare Vek, Alpha Spiders cannot spawn on the first island are are limited to one spawn per mission.

name: Spider Leader
text: Health 6, move 2. Weapons/skills: Plentiful Offspring: Throw out 2-3 Spiderling eggs.. Special: Massive: Massive units can walk in Water (but Water will prevent attacking or repairing).. The Spider Leader starts with two spiderling eggs that hatch before the player turn. Each time the spider leader moves, it will throw two spiderling eggs onto random locations around the map. Unlike normal spiders these eggs do not immobilise adjacent units. Unlike all other leaders Spider Leaders can only appear in the boss mission of an island. On Unfair difficulty, they cannot appear on regular missions in the fourth island.

name: Spiderling Egg
text: Health 1, move 0. Weapons/skills: Spiderling Egg: Hatch into Spiderling.. Special: Smoke Immunity: This unit is unaffected by Smoke.. The Spiderling Eggs are spawned directly by Spiders, Alpha Spiders, and Spider Leaders; and spawned indirectly by Arachnid Psions, which cause other Vek to spawn eggs upon death. The eggs spawned by Spiders and Alpha Spiders appear larger and web adjacent targets upon being created. The egg will, on it's turn, kill itself and spawn a Spiderling

name: Spiderling
text: Health 1, move 3. Weapons/skills: Tiny Mandibles: Weak 1 damage attack against a single adjacent target.. Spiderlings, spawned from Spiderling Eggs, are a very weak 1-health, 1-damage enemy that can quickly overwhelm the player with numbers.

name: Alpha Spiderling
text: Health 1, move 3. Weapons/skills: Tiny Mandibles: Weak 2 damage attack against a single adjacent target..

name: Burrower
text: Health 3, move 4. Weapons/skills: Spiked Carapace: Slam against 3 tiles in a row, hitting each for 1 damage.. Special: Burrower: This Vek will hide underground after taking one or more damage. | Stable : Cannot be moved by any weapon effect (Push, Teleport, etc.).. Burrowers move underground to arrive at their destination and bypass any obstacles, much like a Leaper minus the jumping. When emerging they attack a 3-tile wide area in front of them perpendicular to where they are facing. Upon taking any damage, they will cancel their attack and retreat underground, re-emerging elsewhere (within 4 tiles of where they retreated from) on their next turn. Burrowers can not end their move on top of Ice Tiles. Burrowers are Stable and thus cannot be pushed or moved with physical force, however they can still be relocated by the Control Mech's Control Shot weapon.

name: Alpha Burrower
text: Health 5, move 4. Weapons/skills: Bladed Carapace: Slam against 3 tiles in a row, hitting each for 2 damage.. Special: Burrower: This Vek will hide underground after taking one or more damage. | Stable : Cannot be moved by any weapon effect (Push, Teleport, etc.).. Alpha Burrowers move underground to arrive at their destination and bypass any obstacles, much like a Leaper minus the jumping. When emerging they attack a 3-tile wide area in front of them perpendicular to where they are facing. Upon taking any damage, they will cancel their attack and retreat underground, re-emerging elsewhere (within 4 tiles of where they retreated from) on their next turn. Alpha Burrowers can not end their move on top of Ice Tiles. Alpha Burrowers are Stable and thus cannot be pushed or moved with physical force, however they can still be relocated by the Control Mech's Co

name: Chasm Tile
text: Ground units pushed in will be destroyed.

name: Ice Tile
text: Turns into Water when destroyed. Must be hit twice.; Turns into Water when destroyed. Must be hit once.

name: Fire
text: Units that are on fire take 1 damage near the start of their turn. Units can be lit on fire if they are attacked while on a Forest Tile, or by any weapon that burns the target. A damaged Forest Tile will turn into a burning Forest tile, and will remain on fire until put out by another status effect. A weapon that burns the target will additionally burn the tile they are standing on, turning it into a Fire Tile. Fire Tiles can be placed on top of any non-liquid tiles, including Conveyor Belts. Units that are on fire take 1 damage near the start of their turn. An

name: Sand Tile
text: If damaged, turns into Smoke. Units in Smoke cannot attack or repair.

name: A.C.I.D. Pool
text: Inflicts A.C.I.D. on the 1st unit that steps on this space.

name: A.C.I.D. Tile
text: Behaves like Water, but inflicts A.C.I.D. on surviving units.

name: Mosquito
text: Health 2, move 4. Weapons/skills: Smoked Tentacles: Smoke the target, preparing to whip it for 1 damage.. Special: Flying: Flying units can move over any terrain tile.. Much like the Hornet, Mosquitoes are 2-health flying Vek that have a weak melee attack. Unlike the Hornet, however, Mosquitoes have one less point of movement and apply Smoke to the targeted tile at the end of their movement. Mosquitoes cannot spawn on an island with any other flying Vek (Hornet, Moth) other than the island's Psion.

name: Alpha Mosquito
text: Health 4, move 4. Weapons/skills: Storm Tentacles: Smoke the target, preparing to whip it for 3 damage.. Special: Flying: Flying units can move over any terrain tile.. As a flying enemy with 4 health, the Mosquito is similar to the Alpha Hornet, trading 1 point of movement and the ability to attack 2 tiles for the ability to apply Smoke to the target tile and damage for three points. Mosquitoes and their alpha variant cannot spawn on an island with any other flying Vek (Hornet, Moth) other than the island's Psion.

name: Moth
text: Health 3, move 3. Weapons/skills: Repulsive Pellets: Launch an artillery attack for 1 damage, pushing shooter and target.. Special: Flying: Flying units can move over any terrain tile.. The Moth is a 3-health, 3-move flying Vek that fires an artillery attack much like the Scarab, flying over any tiles to land on the target and deal 1 point of damage. This attack pushes the affected target and the Moth itself away by one tile. Moths cannot spawn on an island with any other flying Vek (Hornet, Mosquito) other than the island's Psion. In addition, they also cannot spawn with either Scarabs or Crabs.

name: Starfish
text: Health 2, move 3. Weapons/skills: Brittle Appendages: Deal 1 damage to four oblique tiles.. Starfish attack by striking the four corner tiles around them, much like a grounded 4-way Hornet. Despite being based off an aquatic creature they are capable of drowning. As a rare Vek, Starfish cannot spawn on the first island are are limited to two spawns per mission.

name: Plasmodia
text: Health 3, move 2. Weapons/skills: Splitting Spores: Launch a short-lived Spore.. Much like the Blobber and Spider, the Plasmodia is a slow-moving spawner Vek that fires a Spore using artillery range. The Spore destroys itself during the enemy turn to shoot a pushing projectile for 1 damage at a certain direction. As a rare Vek, Plasmodia cannot spawn on the first island and are limited to only one spawn per mission. Plasmodia also cannot spawn with either Blobbers, Spiders, the Blobber Leader, Spider Leader or Plasmodia Leader.

name: Tumblebug
text: Health 3, move 3. Weapons/skills: Explosive Prize: Create an explosive boulder, preparing to destroy it next turn by attacking it for 1 damage.. Tumblebugs attack by summoning an Unstable Boulder that will explode when damaged, then threatening to damage it and inflict 1 damage on all of its adjancent tiles, including the Tumblebug. These boulders do not explode if they are not damaged. If a Tumblebug is forced to attack a mech directly it will not summon an unstable boulder. As a rare Vek, Tumblebugs cannot appear on the first island and are restricted to two spawns per mission, including its alpha. They cannot spawn on missions with explosive mines.

name: Bouncer
text: Health 3, move 3. Weapons/skills: Energized Horns: Deal 1 damage to the target then bounce backwards.. Bouncers attack one tile in front of them, much like a Hornet without flight. What differentiates the Bouncer is that it will push the target tile and push themselves back by 1 tile, potentially resulting in a chain of collisions.

name: Gastropod
text: Health 3, move 2. Weapons/skills: Hooked Proboscis: Grapple for 1 damage, pulling the Vek towards objects or units to the Vek.. Gastropods fire a grappling hook that deals 1 damage to the target and either pulls it to the Gastropod or the other way around, depending on if the target is immovable. If the hook does not hit anything the Gastropod does not move. Despite being based off an aquatic animal they are able to drown.

name: Blobber Leader
text: Health 5, move 2. Weapons/skills: Eruptive Growths: Throw a sticky blob that will explode.. Special: Massive: Massive units can walk in Water (but Water will prevent attacking or repairing).. Much like the standard Blobber the Blobber Leader maintains a safe distance from mechs, attempting to attack by spawning Blob Leaders onto any tile on the map. Blob Leaders have two points of health and explode during the enemy turn to damage itself by 1 and adjacent tiles by 2, meaning that they will detonate twice before they naturally die. Blobber Leaders prevent the spawning of both normal and alpha variants of the Blobber, Spider and Plasmodia. In Unfair difficulty during 3 or 4 island gameplay, it's possible for the Blobber Leader to replace an Alpha Blobber at the Volcanic Hive, if Adva

name: Arachnid Psion
text: Health 2, move 2. Weapons/skills: Arachnid Host: All other Vek will spawn a Spiderling Egg on death.. Special: Flying: Flying units can move over any terrain tile.. Arachnid Psions are identifiable by their squid-like cyan body and pink bumps. While alive, they grant all other Vek except for any Blobs, Spores, Spiderlings and Spiderling Eggs the ability to spawn a Spiderling Egg on death. The Spiderling Egg matches those that spawn from the Spider Leader and does not web surrounding tiles. These eggs spawn even if the vek falls into water or a bottomless pit, with the egg flying out of the body of water or hole and landing on a nearby land tile. Psions can only spawn once per mission. The Psionic Receiver will force disabled Mechs to spawn enemy Spiderlin

name: Raging Psion
text: Health 2, move 2. Weapons/skills: Raging Hormones: All other Vek are Boosted, providing +1 damage to attacks.. Special: Flying: Flying units can move over any terrain tile.. Raging Psions are identifiable by their squid-like black body and beige bumps. While alive, they grant all other Vek the boosted effect, increasing their damage by 1. Psions can only spawn once per mission. The Psionic Receiver boosts all mechs when a Raging Psion is present.

name: Smoldering Psion
text: Health 2, move 2. Weapons/skills: Burning Carapace: All other Vek are protected from Fire and leave Fire on death.. Special: Flying: Flying units can move over any terrain tile.. Smoldering Psions are identifiable by their squid-like pink body and blue bumps. While alive, it grant all other Vek fire immunity and make them leave a fire tile on death. Psions can only spawn once per mission. The Psionic Receiver grants fire resistance to all mechs under its presence.

name: Alpha Bouncer
text: Health 4, move 3. Weapons/skills: Powered Horns: Deal 3 damage to the target then bounce backwards.. Bouncers attack one tile in front of them, much like a Hornet without flight. What differentiates the Bouncer is that it will push the target tile and push themselves back by 1 tile, potentially resulting in a chain of collisions.

name: Alpha Gastropod
text: Health 4, move 3. Weapons/skills: Barbed Proboscis: Grapple for 3 damage, pulling the Vek towards objects or units to the Vek.. Alpha Gastropods fire a grappling hook that deals 3 damage to the target and either pulls it to the Alpha Gastropod or the other way around, depending on if the target is immovable. If the hook does not hit anything, the Alpha Gastropod does not move. Despite being based off an aquatic animal, they are able to drown.

name: Alpha Moth
text: Health 5, move 3. Weapons/skills: Repugnant Pellets: Launch an artillery attack for 3 damage, pushing shooter and target.. Special: Flying: Flying units can move over any terrain tile.. The is a 5-health, 3-move flying Vek that fires an artillery attack much like the Scarab, flying over any tiles to land on the target and deal 3 damage. This attack pushes the affected target and the Moth itself away by one tile. Alpha Moths cannot spawn on an island with any other flying Vek (Hornet, Mosquito) other than the island's Psion. In addition, they also cannot spawn with either Scarabs or Crabs.

name: Alpha Plasmodia
text: Health 5, move 2. Weapons/skills: Spawning Spores: Launch a short-lived Alpha Spore.. Much like the Blobber and Spider, the Alpha Plasmodia is a slow-moving spawner Vek that fires an Alpha Spore using artillery range. The Spore destroys itself during the enemy turn to shoot a pushing projectile for 3 damage at a certain direction. As a rare Vek, Alpha Plasmodia cannot spawn on the first island and are limited to one spawn per mission. Alpha Plasmodia also cannot spawn with either Blobbers, Spiders, the Blobber Leader, Spider Leader or Plasmodia Leader.

name: Alpha Starfish
text: Health 4, move 3. Weapons/skills: Lacerated Appendages: Deal 2 damage to four oblique tiles.. attack by striking the four corner tiles around them, much like a grounded 4-way Hornet. Despite being based off an aquatic creature they are capable of drowning. As a rare Vek, Starfish cannot spawn on the first island are are limited to a number of spawns per mission, depending on the number of Islands completed.

name: Alpha Tumblebug
text: Health 5, move 3. Weapons/skills: Explosive Prize: Create an explosive boulder, preparing to destroy it next turn by attacking it for 3 damage.. The attacks by summoning an Unstable Boulder and threatening to destroy it with a 3 damage attack, causing the boulder to inflict 1 damage to adjacent tiles (including the Tumblebug). These boulders do not explode if they are not damaged. If an is forced to attack an object or unit directly it will not summon an unstable boulder. As a rare Vek, Tumblebugs cannot appear on the first island and are restricted to two spawns per mission. They cannot spawn on missions with explosive mines.

name: Mosquito Leader
text: Health 5, move 4. Weapons/skills: Cloudburst Tentacles: Smoke and Web the target, preparing to whip it with a devastating attack. Kills target.. Special: Flying: Flying units can move over any terrain tile.. The Mosquito leader moves and attempts to attack a single adjacent tile, applying both smoke and webbing effects, waiting for one player turn before dealing Kill damage. This means that if a mech is targeted it cannot respond due to the combination of smoke and webs unless they are immune through Camila Vera's ability or Nanofilter Mending's smoke removal effect.

name: Tumblebug Leader
text: Health 6, move 3. Weapons/skills: Explosive Prizes: Create two explosive boulders, preparing to destroy one next turn by attacking it for 3 damage.. Special: Massive: Massive units can walk in Water (but Water will prevent attacking or repairing).. The Tumblebug Leader attacks by spawning two Unstable Boulders in front of it and threatening to attack the tile in front for 3 damage. Unstable Boulders have the explosive decay effect, making them capable of damaging multiple buildings when just one of them sets off. These boulders also do not die off when the Tumblebug Leader is killed and remain as obstacles. If a Tumblebug has no space to make boulders it will simply attack an adjacent tile directly. Tumblebug Leaders cannot spawn on the Volcanic Hive, like most Advanced Edition Vek. They also cannot spawn on missions with explosive mines

name: Bouncer Leader
text: Health 4, move 3. Weapons/skills: Sweeping Horns: Deal 2 damage to and push three tiles then bounce backwards.. Special: Massive: Massive units can walk in Water (but Water will prevent attacking or repairing). | Natural Armor: Weapon damage to this unit is reduced by 1. All other damage (Push, Blocking, Fire, etc.) is unaffected.. The Bouncer Leader attacks in a 3x1 rectangle perpendicular to the direction it is facing and pushes them away, while bouncing itself backwards. It has Natural Armor like the Hook Mech and thus takes 1 less damage from weapons, but not from other damage sources such as blocking spawns, collisions or fire. Bouncer Leaders cannot spawn on the Volcanic Hive like all Advanced Edition vek.

name: Starfish Leader
text: Health 6, move 3. Weapons/skills: Scored Appendages: Deal 3 damage to 4 oblique tiles and push 4 others.. Special: Massive: Massive units can walk in Water (but Water will prevent attacking or repairing).. The Starfish Leader attacks for 3 damage to the four corner tiles and pushes the four adjacent tiles outward.

name: Centipede Leader
text: Health 7, move 3. Weapons/skills: Caustic Vomit: Launch a volatile mass of goo for 3 damage, applying A.C.I.D. on nearby units and all tiles it passes through.. Special: Massive: Massive units can walk in Water (but Water will prevent attacking or repairing).. The Centipede leader fires a projectile goo that damages the tile and the two nearby ones perpendicular to its direction, acidifying both the damaged tiles and all tiles that it passes through.

name: Crab Leader
text: Health 6, move 3. Weapons/skills: Raining Expulsions: Launch 2 damage artillery attack that also deals 1 damage to every tile in its path.. Special: Massive: Massive units can walk in Water (but Water will prevent attacking or repairing).. The Crab Leader attacks by firing a lobbing projectile that damages each tile it passes for 1 damage each and the final tile for 2 damage. It will prioritize targeting as many units and buildings as possible. In Unfair difficulty during 3 or 4 island gameplay, it's possible for the Crab Leader to replace an Alpha Crab at the Volcanic Hive, if Advanced Enemies are turned on for that timeline.

name: Boom Cannon
text: Health 1, move 3. Weapons/skills: Cannon 8R Mark I: Projectile that causes target to burn and deals 1 damage.. Special: Explosive Decay: Explodes on death, dealing 1 damage to adjacent tiles.. An orange Cannon-Bot, identical in stats and weapon damage, with the distinct difference of exploding after being destroyed. They will only appear in the Destroy all Boom-Bots objective; 4 variants total, with 2 starting frozen. The player gains 1 per 2 boom bots destroyed, for a total of 2 possible reputation that can be earned.

name: Boom Artillery
text: Health 1, move 3. Weapons/skills: Vk8 Rockets Mark I: Launch Rockets at 3 tiles dealing 1 damage to each (5 tile range).. Special: Explosive Decay: Explodes on death, dealing 1 damage to adjacent tiles.. An orange Artillery-Bot, identical in stats and weapon damage, with the distinct difference of exploding after being destroyed. They will only appear in the Destroy all Boom-Bots objective; 4 variants total, with 2 starting frozen. The player gains 1 per 2 boom bots destroyed, for a total of 2 possible reputation that can be earned.
